title: Empirical Complexity Analyser
instructions: In `growth.py` implement `measure` (minimum of `timeit.repeat` timings per call, input built outside the timer), `growth_exponent` (least-squares slope of log time against log size), `classify` and `analyse`. The tests use synthetic timings, so focus on correct maths and on not timing input construction.

evidence.label: Recovers exponents 0, 1 and 2 from exact power-law timings
Fits a least-squares line through all points, not just the first two
Classifies exponents with the documented thresholds (0.4, 1.35, 2.5)
Raises ValueError for too few points, mismatched lengths, non-positive or equal sizes
measure returns one float timing per size
measure takes the minimum of the repeats, divides by number and builds inputs once outside the timer
analyse returns (exponent, label) from measured timings
